assertion.rationale: F9 (Task 13, partial close): platform/main.bicep now routes diagnosticSettings for Key Vault (AuditEvent -- the estate's only real credentials), the cost-export storage account (account-level metrics and blob-service-level data-plane logs), the SQL database (Microsoft.Sql/servers/databases, not the server resource -- verified against the avm/res/sql/server@0.22.0 module schema, which has no top-level diagnosticSettings param) and the Container Apps environment, all to the Log Analytics workspace. SQL auditSettings now sets isAzureMonitorTargetEnabled: true, so the previously-nominal audit (state: Enabled, no destination) actually writes somewhere. layer-06-platform.yml now also routes the subscription Activity Log (Administrative/Security/Policy/etc.) to the same workspace. What remains ungenerated: Entra ID SignInLogs and AuditLogs. Task 13 found this needs a live tenant to verify -- the Microsoft.aadiam tenant-scoped diagnostic-settings resource shape and the Entra role the deployer SP would need are both unconfirmed without one -- and recorded that rather than shipping unverified syntax. Directory-plane authentication/authorization events (sign-ins, CA policy evaluations, directory role changes) are therefore still not generated anywhere in the estate; every Azure-resource-plane audit record now is.

recommendation: Route Entra ID SignInLogs and AuditLogs to the Log Analytics workspace (Microsoft.aadiam tenant-scoped diagnostic settings) once the resource-id shape and required Entra role can be verified against a live tenant -- this is the one remaining contributor to this control. Everything else Task 13's original recommendation asked for (Key Vault/storage/SQL/CAE diagnosticSettings, SQL isAzureMonitorTargetEnabled, Activity Log) is DONE.
